C1.statement: ErrClosed is a package-level error value whose message is "pool is closed".

C2.statement: The Pool interface declares method Get() (interface{}, error).

C3.statement: The Pool interface declares method Put(interface{}) error.

C4.statement: The Pool interface declares method Close(interface{}) error.

C5.statement: The Pool interface declares method Release().

C6.statement: The Pool interface declares method Len() int.

C7.statement: A comment documents ErrClosed as indicating the connection pool is already closed.

questions: What are the error semantics of Get, Put, and Close? The interface does not specify when errors are returned.
Which conditions cause ErrClosed to be returned? The interface methods do not document use of ErrClosed.
Is Pool safe for concurrent use? The interface does not specify concurrency safety.
What is the behaviour of Get, Put, Close, or Len after Release is called? This is unspecified.
What does Release do relative to Close? The relationship between the two methods is unspecified.
What does Len count (total, idle, in-use, etc.)? The interface does not specify.
Does Put have ownership or blocking semantics? The interface does not specify.
Does Close take ownership of the passed value or return it to the pool? The interface does not specify.
Is there any ordering requirement between Put and Get, or between Release and other methods? None is stated.
